description:
Small residuals recorded across the 2026-07 remediation batch reviews:
1. platforms/base/tuning.py:109 still passes display platform_name to
   is_compatible_with_platform (zero runtime call sites; flagged in #1174).
2. ClickHouseTuningMixin.apply_platform_optimizations reads
   platform_config.clickhouse_optimizations - an attribute
   PlatformOptimizationConfiguration never defines; pre-existing dead/broken
   code that raises if invoked (found during applied-ledger work).
3. Module-size guardrail exact-fit races: two batch PRs tripped
   tests/system/test_module_size_thresholds.py because limits are set to the
   exact current size; adopt a small headroom convention (e.g. +25 lines)
   with a comment documenting it.
4. Blind-spot bookkeeping: triage the five 2026-07-12 tuning blind-spots to
   actioned via sweep_blind_spots.py (all were remediated by the batch), and
   add one new capture for the newly-proven class: config silently lost
   across a serialization boundary between producer and consumer (the
   from_config gap).

preserves.behavior: Guardrail still fails on real unbounded growth (headroom is small and documented)

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/platforms tests/system/test_module_size_thresholds.py -q -k 'tuning or size'
verifications.expected: All passing; validate_blind_spot.py OK on new/changed captures

work_units.summary: Canonicalize or remove the tuning.py:109 display-name path
Fix or delete the dead clickhouse_optimizations branch (decide by reading callers; add test either way)
Guardrail headroom convention in test_module_size_thresholds.py with documented policy
Blind-spot triage (5x actioned) + new capture for the serialization-boundary config-loss class; validate files
